reference_route: B: independently generated D1D2 groups (not KinCoRe labels); see results/reference_source_check.json
evidence_scope: structural-label recovery only; no function, drug response or biological validation

reference_rule.D1: distance between the Cα of the residue four after the αC Glu and the Cζ of the DFG Phe, Å
reference_rule.D2: distance between the Cα of the β3 Lys and the Cζ of the DFG Phe, Å
reference_rule.grouping: average-linkage hierarchical clustering (scipy, Euclidean on D1, D2) of the development points into 3 groups; groups named by rule; evaluation points are assigned to the nearest development group centroid, never refitted
reference_rule.naming: out = group with the largest mean D1; of the other two, in = the one with more members, inter = the one with fewer
reference_rule.source_of_definition: Modi & Dunbrack, PNAS 116:6818-6827 (2019) defines D1, D2 and the clustering method; numeric boundaries are not published in the text, so the boundaries here are fitted on development data and are not the official ones
reference_rule.inter_handling: reported, excluded from the primary task

development.control_basis: published structures of an imatinib-Abl complex, a BIRB-796-p38 complex and a cyclin-A-CDK2 complex; literature expectations used only as a sanity gate, not as validation

evaluation.exclude: UniProt accessions in ../kin_pair_1/results/exposure_history.json, the KIN-PAIR-1 panel targets (EGFR, PIM1, BTK), and the development kinases
evaluation.ranking: RCSB search count (target accession, X-ray, resolution <= 2.5 A), descending; ties by accession
evaluation.stop_when: pooled evaluation entries labelled out >= 15 from at least 3 kinases

entry_rules.one_chain_per_entry: alphabetically first chain of the target entity that passes every rule below
entry_rules.mapping: existing kinase_roles helper, defaults (identity >= 0.90, >= 30 aligned, role mutations refused), against the UniProt canonical sequence, one-chain numbering by alignment, never by number
entry_rules.window: 9 residues DFG-Asp-3 .. DFG-Asp+5 (reference indices), all observed with a Cα, consecutive in the reference and in the deposited numbering, Cα-Cα <= 4.2 A, residue names standard or MSE; otherwise the entry is excluded with the reason
entry_rules.reference_atoms: Cα of the β3 Lys and of the αC Glu+4 and Cζ of the DFG Phe observed (altloc: blank, else A)
entry_rules.modified_residues: an entry with another non-standard residue name in the window is excluded and recorded

anchors.beta3_Lys: the unique UniProt ATP-binding-site Lys inside the first 60 residues of the UniProt kinase domain
anchors.HRD_H: UniProt active site Asp minus 2 (the helper checks H or Y, R, D)
anchors.DFG_Asp: MotifWindow(active site + 10, end of the UniProt kinase domain): exactly one DFG
anchors.alphaC_Glu: the Glu of reference window [beta3 Lys + 12, + 25] whose carboxylate O is within 4.5 A of the Lys NZ in the largest number of that kinase's mapped entries; needs at least 3 entries and a lead of at least 2 over the next Glu
anchors.failure: a kinase without a unique anchor set is excluded and recorded

representations.T: TopoFold core kappa (7 interior vertices) and tau (6 hinges as sin and cos) from compute_ca_features: 19 values, z-scored with the development mean and standard deviation; Euclidean distance
representations.B1: window-matched Cα distances d(i-1,i+1) at the 7 vertices and d(i-1,i+2) at the 6 hinges: 13 values, z-scored on development; Euclidean
representations.B2: local Cα RMSD between two windows after the optimal proper rotation (Kabsch)
representations.B3: all 36 Cα-Cα distances inside the window, z-scored on development; Euclidean
representations.primary_baseline: the one of B1, B2, B3 with the highest development leave-one-kinase-out balanced accuracy (fixed on development before any evaluation scoring)

prediction.method: k-nearest neighbours among development entries (the same procedure for every representation)
prediction.k_selection: highest mean development leave-one-kinase-out balanced accuracy per representation; ties: the smaller k
prediction.score: fraction of the k nearest development neighbours labelled out
prediction.development_set: development entries labelled in or out (inter excluded)

metric.primary: weighted balanced accuracy = (weighted TPR + weighted TNR) / 2 on the evaluation entries labelled out or in; each (kinase, class) cell has equal weight within its class
secondary: per-kinase TPR and TNR with counts
performance restricted to kinases below the family-flag identity
metric.inference: none: descriptive only (few independent kinases; permutation or interval claims are not justified)

outcomes.insufficient_evidence: any gate fails, or evaluation out < 10, or kinases with >= 1 out < 3, or kinases with >= 5 in < 3
outcomes.advantage: BA_w(T) - BA_w(primary baseline) >= 0.10 and BA_w(T) >= 0.70 and T >= baseline in at least two thirds of the kinases that have both classes (at least 3 such kinases needed)
outcomes.cA_only_limitation: reported separately: supported if the best Cα-only representation has BA_w < 0.80 (the full-atom reference rule defines the labels, so its agreement with them is 1 by construction and is not a performance claim)

gates: G1 core kappa/tau equal the numpy reference <= 1e-4
G2 rigid-motion invariance of every representation <= 1e-6
G3 Kabsch RMSD equals MDAnalysis QCP <= 1e-4
G4 role residues are Asp-Phe-Gly, Glu, Lys; shifted-by-one control fails
G5 development controls: 1IEP out, 1KV2 out, 1FIN in
G6 development groups: out >= 8 and inter >= 3 members
G7 development and evaluation share no kinase and no PDB entry
G8 D1, D2 equal an independent MDAnalysis recomputation <= 1e-3 A
